description:
'''Manguebeat,''' alternatively known as '''mangue beat''' or '''mangue bit''', is a social and artistic movement with origins in [[Northeast Region, Brazil|northeastern Brazilian]] city [[Recife]], [[Pernambuco]] in the early 1900s, in reaction to the economic and cultural stagnation of the capital. 

Even though the movement has a strong focus on music, it also spans fashion, slang and visual art. Manguebeat compositions are known for their mix of regional rhythms, like [[maracatu]], [[frevo]], [[Coco (music)|coco]] and [[forró]], with international genres like [[Rock music|rock]], [[Soul music|soul]], [[ragga]]muffin, [[hip hop music|hip hop]], [[funk]] and [[electronic music]].
